name: archvision
description: Arch-3d build — blueprint or description to editable 3D design, materials, equipment, and budget estimate. Built for architects.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
